title: nervilia bicarinata
intro: Nervilia bicarinata, commonly known as the Two-horned Nervilia, is a species of orchid native to tropical Asia. This plant has been found to have various health benefits, including its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Nervilia bicarinata include its possible use in treating fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as its potential antiviral and antibacterial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
